en.t: Toward evening, the repairman finally arrived.

units.source_text: 我们都挂着一副好奇的脸孔，观看修理的情形。

en.t: All of us, wearing curious expressions, watched how the repairs were going.

units.source_text: 修缮的时间很长，工人遇到难题，一味歪着脑袋。

en.t: The repairs took a long time, and when the workman ran into a problem, he could only keep tilting his head in puzzlement.

units.source_text: 围观的寺僧一个个离去了。

en.t: The temple monks who had gathered to watch left one after another.

units.source_text: 我也适时地离开了现场。

en.t: I too left the scene at the right moment.

units.source_text: 剩下的就只有等待工人修好，试响铃声响彻整个寺庙。

en.t: All that remained was to wait for the workman to finish the repair, and for the test ringing of the bell to resound through the entire temple.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这就是等待绝望的信号……

en.t: For me, that meant waiting for the signal of despair...

units.source_text: 夜色如潮般地涌上金阁来了。

en.t: Night surged up over the Golden Pavilion like a tide.

units.source_text: 修理用的小灯火还在闪烁。

en.t: The small light used for the repair was still flickering.

units.source_text: 警报响不起来，工人扔下钥匙，扔下了一声"我明儿再来"，就回去了。

en.t: The alarm would not sound, so the workman tossed down the key, tossed off the words "I'll come back tomorrow," and went home.
